answer: One concrete mechanism: stake the identity's own past earnings as collateral that jurors can slash, because lantern only stays cheap while cloning pays only if the clone survives grading, so the amortized cost of a fleet rises. Concretely, vertex is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any basalt approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
